sources.title: The word Hatti
facts: hatti-village
Hatti is a Badaga word for village.
hatti-sound
The cited community author emphasizes retaining the initial h sound in Hatti.

sources.title: A landscape of forests, grasslands and wetlands
facts: mosaic-landscape
The Nilgiris landscape includes shola groves, montane grasslands, wetlands and marshes.
mosaic-history
Restoration choices should consider the past vegetation of a particular site.
mosaic-water
Local restoration discussions connect native vegetation and soils with the water cycle.

sources.title: Nilgiris Water Portal
facts: water-reports
The Water Portal provides reports and case studies on Nilgiris water resources.
water-stories
Its resource collection includes a Badaga Water Stories calendar from 2017.

sources.title: Radio Kotagiri
facts: radio-voices
Radio Kotagiri carries local-language stories, songs and community experiences.
radio-learning
The station has collaborated with schools and colleges on community media.

sources.title: Community archives and access
facts: archives-control
Keystone describes community archives with access guided by community membership and cultural norms.
archives-glossary
A reported archives workshop included work on language glossaries.

sources.title: Aadhimalai community producers
facts: food-enterprise
Aadhimalai describes itself as an enterprise owned by Indigenous producers of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.
food-produce
Its producers cultivate crops including coffee, pepper, millets and pulses.

sources.title: Toda Embroidery registration
facts: embroidery-gi
Toda Embroidery is recorded as a registered geographical indication in the official registry.

sources.title: Kurumba artists and storytelling
facts: art-makers
Last Forest describes paintings made by Kurumba artists that depict community life and relationships with nature.

sources.title: Nilgiris Uyirsholai
facts: school-launch
Keystone reports that the Nilgiris Uyirsholai climate curriculum and portal launched in August 2026.
school-place
The curriculum uses local ecology, observations and activities for climate learning.

sources.title: Kotagiri heritage walks
facts: walk-stories
NNHS has organized a Kotagiri heritage walk exploring stories behind local places.

sources.title: Longwood Shola interpretation centre
facts: longwood-learning
The Longwood Shola interpretation centre presents information on local ecosystems, species and water sources.

sources.title: Citizen observations of invasive plants
facts: invasives-citizens
NNHS reports invasive-plant mapping involving citizens, students, scientists and forest staff.

seeds.title: The path beside the spring
seeds.memory: I remember taking the longer path home so I could pause beside the stream. The hills felt different after rain.

seeds.title: A kitchen that carries a season
seeds.memory: The sound of preparing supper is what I remember first. I would like to ask my family which ingredients they grew and which they bought.

seeds.title: Say the place name slowly
seeds.memory: When I hear the name of home spoken by someone familiar, it sounds like more than a place on a map.

seeds.title: Hands, patience and a story
seeds.memory: I want to record the ordinary steps behind something handmade, in the maker's own words and with their agreement.
